info.title: Gani Platform API — planned
info.description: Paths NOT served yet (`x-status: planned`, `x-sprint`): the contract the front end builds on until each moves to openapi.json. Same rules as openapi.json: session cookie, organisation from the session, RFC 9457 errors with a snake_case `code`.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; `code` is the stable word (Brief P9).

teamId.description: The team that answers the channel; null: the default team of the workspace.

monthlyBudgetUsd.description: The budget of one calendar month in the time zone of the workspace (`workspace.timezone`), in USD. BudgetGuard warns at 80% and stops at 100% (`ai_budget_exceeded`, back to the scripted flow); 0 means the internal AI is stopped at once (used ≥ budget, U74).

usedThisMonthUsd.description: Spent since the month began in `workspace.timezone` (ai_usage_logs).

resetsAt.description: When the next month begins in `workspace.timezone`, and the spending starts again at 0. The budget itself never resets: it stays what was set (U74).

productionLocked.description: true while `production` is refused (409 `ai_production_locked`), for every role, the Owner included: the UI warns before any PATCH. Always sent by the API once built.

productionLockReason.description: Why `production` is locked: `legal_q1` while Q1 (legal) is not settled; null when not locked.

aiCostMonthVnd.description: null until the AI Gateway exists; Q1 still locks production (U65, CEO 05/11/2026).

endedAt.description: When it ended: `expiresAt` once it ran out, or when the operator ended it.

endReason.description: `manual`: the operator ended it early (`POST …/end`); `expired`: it ran its 60 minutes; null while it runs.

get.summary: The access sessions of the operator who calls, newest first (only their own).
get.description: A session is applied with the header `X-Access-Session-Id: <id>` on each request into the organisation’s data. The header carries only the id of the session: the organisation is read from the stored session, never from the header (rule 1). The tenant middleware checks it on every request, whatever the controller: the session must be the caller’s (`operatorUserId` = the user of the session) and neither expired nor ended, else 403 `access_session_expired`. A session opens reading only: it gives no role in the organisation, and the second factor and every per-resource check still apply.

400.description: validation_failed: a parameter or the cursor.
